research_notes.finding: Citation generation should integrate with TanStack AI's tool result handling, using the tool's returned metadata to extract source information and generate inline citations.
Click navigation: Use useNavigate hook with state parameter to pass citation data when navigating to source preview.
Modern citation systems use: (1) inline bracketed citations [1], (2) hover previews with relevance scores, (3) click-to-navigate to full source context.

architecture_patterns.pattern: Citation should include: id, sourceId, sourceTitle, relevanceScore, excerpt, position (start/end in response)
Use TanStack Router's useNavigate with state parameter for context preservation
Follow Zustand + Dexie pattern from rag-store.ts

technical_notes.note: AC1: Citation format - Use inline brackets [source-1], [source-2] matching existing CitationSidebar component
AC3: Click navigation - Must open SourcePreviewPanel, not navigate away from chat
AC4: Citation count badge - Place in RAGChatPanel header (top-right corner)
AC5: Citation filtering - Should use existing source filter if available
